chunks: From him, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, from Humran ibn A'yan, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Words of the Mighty and Majestic: 'We have shown him the way, [so let him choose] either a grateful one or a thankful one.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Either he accepts [the Wilayah], so he is a grateful one, or he neglects [it], so he is an unbeliever.'

key_terms.إِنَّا هَدَيْناهُ السَّبِيلَ: We have shown him the way

ai.seo_question: How does the Imam interpret the terms 'grateful' and 'unthankful' in Surah Al-Insan?
ai.summary: In this exegetical narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the terms 'shakir' (grateful) and 'kafur' (unthankful) are interpreted through the lens of acceptance and rejection of divine authority (Wilayah), effectively linking gratitude to faith and ingratitude to disbelief. This interpretation highlights the Shia theological emphasis on the cognitive and volitional aspect of 'Kufr' as a rejection of truth rather than merely a lack of thanksgiving, reinforcing the centrality of Imamate in salvation. Such readings underscore the dynamic relationship between human free will and divine guidance as presented in Surah Al-Insan.
